cases.description: 验证大区字段值 exact-first 召回和销售额指标生成。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t2.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM dim_region t1 JOIN fact_order t2 ON t1.region_id = t2.region_id WHERE t1.region_name = '华北'

cases.description: 验证华东大区过滤不会误用华北。

cases.query: 统计华南大区的订单数
cases.description: 验证华南大区过滤和订单数指标生成。
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华南'

cases.query: 统计美的品牌的销售额
cases.description: 验证品牌字段值召回和销售额指标生成。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t2.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM dim_product t1 JOIN fact_order t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id WHERE t1.brand = '美的'

cases.query: 统计食品饮料品类的销售额
cases.description: 验证商品品类字段值召回和销售额指标生成。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order t1 JOIN dim_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id WHERE t2.category = '食品饮料'

cases.query: 统计手机数码品类的销量
cases.description: 验证手机数码品类过滤和销量指标生成。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.order_quantity) AS total_sales FROM fact_order t1 JOIN dim_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id WHERE t2.category = '手机数码'

cases.query: 按会员等级统计 2025 年第一季度的订单数和销售额
cases.description: 验证会员等级分组、季度日期边界和双指标生成。
cases.sql: SELECT dc.member_level AS member_level, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY dc.member_level

cases.query: 统计 2025 年 3 月各商品品类的销量和销售额
cases.description: 验证月度日期过滤、商品品类分组和多指标生成。
cases.sql: SELECT dp.category AS category, SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.date_id >= 20250301 AND dd.date_id <= 20250331 GROUP BY dp.category

cases.query: 统计 2025 年第一季度各大区的 GMV，并按 GMV 从高到低排序
cases.description: 验证季度日期过滤、大区分组和 GMV 降序排序。
cases.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS region, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id = d.date_id JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id = r.region_id WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC

cases.query: 统计华北地区美的品牌的销售额
cases.description: 验证大区和品牌两个过滤条件同时生效。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t2.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order t2 JOIN dim_product t1 ON t2.product_id = t1.product_id JOIN dim_region t3 ON t2.region_id = t3.region_id WHERE t1.brand = '美的' AND t3.region_name = '华北'

cases.query: 统计华东地区食品饮料品类的销量
cases.description: 验证大区和商品品类组合过滤。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.order_quantity) AS total_sales FROM fact_order t1 JOIN dim_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id JOIN dim_region t3 ON t1.region_id = t3.region_id WHERE t3.region_name = '华东' AND t2.category = '食品饮料'

cases.query: 统计 2025 年第一季度华南大区的销售额
cases.description: 验证日期范围和大区过滤组合。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order t1 JOIN dim_date t2 ON t1.date_id = t2.date_id JOIN dim_region t3 ON t1.region_id = t3.region_id WHERE t2.year = 2025 AND t2.quarter = 'Q1' AND t3.region_name = '华南'

cases.query: 统计 2025 年 3 月的销售额
cases.description: 验证单月销售额统计不应额外引入分组。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order WHERE date_id >= 20250301 AND date_id <= 20250331

cases.description: 验证泛问销售额时不应凭空添加地区过滤。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order

cases.query: 对比华北和华东的销售额
cases.description: 验证多地区对比问法能同时保留两个地区值。
cases.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name IN ('华北', '华东') GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.query: 统计 2025 年第一季度美的品牌的订单数
cases.description: 验证品牌过滤、季度日期过滤和订单数指标组合。
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dp.brand = '美的' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1'

cases.query: 按大区统计食品饮料品类的销售额
cases.description: 验证固定品类过滤下按大区分组统计。
cases.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS region, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_sales FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = '食品饮料' GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.query: 统计 2025 年 3 月华北地区手机数码品类的销量
cases.description: 验证日期、大区、品类三个过滤条件同时生效。
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.order_quantity) AS total_sales FROM fact_order t1 JOIN dim_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id JOIN dim_region t3 ON t1.region_id = t3.region_id JOIN dim_date t4 ON t1.date_id = t4.date_id WHERE t2.category = '手机数码' AND t3.region_name = '华北' AND t4.date_id >= 20250301 AND t4.date_id <= 20250331
